messages:
deploy-bot: /deploy attempt: user alex triggered deploy of service-embedder@release/3.4.1 -> production. commit: 1a2b3c4d tag: release/3.4.1. Concurrent deploy limit for prod=1, currently running=1. Placing in queue (position=2).

alex: hmm, this is a hotfix for customer X, can we fast-track?

jordan: bumping global limit is risky right now. what is running?

deploy-bot: Running job: service-scheduler@main by priya (job#4821). started ~4m ago. ETA ~6m to completion.

priya: scheduler restart includes a small migration, halfway through. cancelling is risky.

samir: +1 on not cancelling, migration must finish to avoid split-state.

alex: ok — alternative: can we run embedder to canary pool instead?

jordan: canary pool (us-west-canary) is available but this release toggles `enable_schema_migration` which is unsafe on canary.

alex: can priya pause her job for ~3m so mine can go? we only need to apply app changes.

priya: doing a pause now. command run: `/deploy pause 4821` — paused :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: job 4821 paused by priya. Re-evaluating queue. Next in queue: service-embedder@release/3.4.1 (position=1). Initiating deploy to prod for alex.

deploy-bot: [start] service-embedder@release/3.4.1 -> prod. job#4832. image: registry/redwood/service-embedder:release-3.4.1. commit: 1a2b3c4d. streaming logs...

alex: tailing logs now. scope: warmup cache + endpoint rollout. will watch for 5xx.

deploy-bot: [progress] container pull OK, migrations skipped (flag=false), healthchecks passing 3/3.

deploy-bot: [finish] job#4832 SUCCESS. Duration: 4m12s. release tag: release/3.4.1. :tada:

alex: thanks team. pushing release notes to docs: https://redwood/docs/releases/3.4.1

jordan: note for post-mortem: queueing happened because prod concurrency=1. suggest we discuss temporary concurrency bump during change window next week or add pre-emptible priority for urgent fixes.

priya: re: paused job 4821 — resuming now. `/deploy resume 4821` -> resumed.

deploy-bot: job 4821 resumed.

samir: FYI observed a small spike in api latency during the transition window (~120ms for 90th pct), but no errors. worth a follow-up in perf-dash.

jordan: opened tracking ticket: https://redwood/ops/tickets/INC-2026.

alex: closing the loop — will request a one-hour change window next Tue to allow up to 2 concurrent prod deploys for critical patches.

deploy-bot: thread archived by system after 1h of inactivity.
